features.title: Product features
features.description: Current application and session capabilities that are not repeated in the provider or model-family tool tables.

rows.name: Session organization
rows.description: Search and filter sessions, edit titles, pin important work, archive sessions, assign workflow status, and keep useful ordering.

rows.name: Session actions
rows.description: Copy, fork, and delete sessions through application-owned actions.

rows.name: Generated titles
rows.description: Generate a session title and description with a configured model.

rows.name: Range summaries
rows.description: Summarize a selected range of conversation history without replacing provider-native compaction.

rows.name: Snapshots and recovery
rows.description: Create and restore recovery points around destructive history changes and compaction workflows.

rows.name: File and URL context
rows.description: Insert local file content or fetched web-page context through composer markers.

rows.name: Configuration and prompt control
rows.description: Inspect and adjust provider options, system messages, session settings, and plugin-contributed controls.

rows.name: Usage, cost, and timing
rows.description: Show provider usage, locally estimated or provider-reported cost, timestamps, and optional duration information when available.

rows.name: Message and session export
rows.description: Export selected content as Markdown, PDF, or EPUB/Kindle-compatible files.

providers.title: Provider support
providers.description: Selected provider-native capabilities that materially change the user experience. General streaming and ordinary tool calling are omitted.
